title: ZA-2022-8791-ZAD-SPP-1A
text:
ZA-2022-8791-ZAD-SPP-1A  Council District: 7 – Rodriguez
  CEQA: ENV-2022-8792-CE  Last Day to Act: 09-30-26
  Plan Area: Sunland – Tujunga – Lake View Terrace –
  Shadow Hills – East La Tuna Canyon

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  7921 West Denivelle Road

  PROPOSED PROJECT:
  The construction, use and maintenance of a new 1,869 square-foot two-story single-family dwelling with a
  369 square-foot attached garage.

  APPEAL:
  An appeal of the July 1, 2026 Zoning Administrator’s determination which:
  1. Determined, based on the whole of the administrative record, that the Project is exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15303, Class 3,
  and that there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that any exceptions contained in Section
  15300.2 of the State CEQA Guidelines regarding location, cumulative impacts, significant effects or
  unusual circumstances, scenic highways, or hazardous waste sites or historical resources applies;

  2.  Denied, pursuant to Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.28(a)(7)(i) of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC),
  a Zoning Administrator's Determination to permit the construction of a new single-family dwelling on a
  lot fronting a Substandard Hillside Limited Street without providing a 20-foot wide adjacent minimum
  roadway as required by LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.21 C.10(i)(2);
  3.  Approved, pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 12.24 X.28(a)(7)(ii), a Zoning Administrator's
  Determination to permit the construction of a new single-family dwelling on a lot that does not have a
  vehicular access route from a street improved with a minimum 20-foot-wide continuous paved roadway
  from the driveway apron to the boundary of the Hillside Area as required by LAMC Chapter 1 Section
  12.21 C.10(i)(3);
  4.  Approved, pursuant to LAMC Chapter 1 Section 11.5.7.C, a Project Permit Compliance review for the
  construction of a new 1,869 square-foot, two-story single-family dwelling with an attached 369 square-
  foot garage in the San Gabriel/ Verdugo Mountains Scenic Preservation Specific Plan; and
  5.  Adopted the Conditions of Approval and Findings.

  Applicant:  Gegam Burnazyan & Ara Amyan
  Representative: Jake Malott

  Appellant:  Thomas Edward Bauer
  Representative: Karey Lyne Call

  Staff:  Dang Nguyen, City Planner
  dang.nguyen@lacity.org
  (818) 374-5050

  Undine Petrulis, Associate Zoning Administrator
summary: Appeal of Zoning Administrator's approval to construct a new single-family dwelling on a substandard hillside street at 7921 West Denivelle Road.
